title: Valhallowed manifest
description: The settings of one install, written in TOML (G18). A later version only adds settings, or migrates a renamed key. Reconcile enforces what this schema cannot express: no two worlds' port ranges overlap.

schema.description: The schema version this file is written against.

world.description: The worlds this install runs: one table per world, keyed by its save name. With more than one world, every world sets its port.

port.description: The TCP port the web map listens on.

save_name.description: A world's save name: the save the game loads, or creates when none has that name. VHD accepts 1 to 64 letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and underscores, starting and ending with a letter or digit. That is stricter than the game, and widens only on evidence.

port.description: The first of the world's three UDP ports, its port through port+2. Defaults to 2456 when the install runs one world.
